overview: Jamie Oliver brings some festive flair to his gnarly fare, as he gets the seasonal celebrations underway with delicious crowd-pleasers and family favourites.
title: Jamie Cooks Christmas

overview: Mass suicide or massacre? The almost unbelievable story of the Order of the Solar Temple, an obscure death cult that shocked the world.
title: Sirius: An Apocalyptic Order

overview: The series deals with three groups: modern businessmen - drug dealers and their subordinates, police officers and finally teenagers and their parents all operating in the seedy underbelly of Belgrade.
title: Група

overview: GOSHO collection reveals the origin of the smash hit "Detective Conan." "GO" into his world, and we will "SHO" you SEVEN romantic and exciting stories created by GOSHO AOYAMA. This is an OVA release.
title: Aoyama Goushou Tanpenshuu

overview: Portugal. Early '80s. A group of criminals spreads terror across the Algarve, with more than twenty bank robberies. The gang is led by a man they call "the Doctor" and a carpenter named Faustino Cavaco with the nickname "the American".
title: O Americano

overview: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life — and a way out.
title: Lucky

overview: The newly qualified specialist Nina Hansen should actually take over her uncle's practice in two years. But suddenly the aging general practitioner Harry Hansen has health problems. When the cosmetic surgeon David Heller saves his life, his uncle makes a decision: In order to be able to cut back on his professional life, both are more committed at the same time: his niece and the cosmetic surgeon, who is still assuming that he will only temporarily step in as a substitute doctor. Because for him, treating patients with statutory health insurance is a chore and completely unprofitable. Uncle Harry, however, relies on his good heart and hopes that his niece will also find good things about the young doctor so that they can continue his practice together. - For the time being, however, two worlds collide that couldn't be more different.
title: Auf Herz und Nieren

overview: Dating Black sheds light on the experiences of Black men and women in the pursuit of love.
title: Dating Black

overview: When their daughter-in-law turns out to be barren, a wealthy Iraqi family decides to resort to a surrogate mother to keep their bloodline going.
title: Umm Badeela

overview: Meng Fan was diagnosed with a terminal illness and died, but unexpectedly triggered a one-year infinite reincarnation loop. After his 1,001st reincarnation, he finally broke free from the cycle and returned to his high school days ten years ago. By now, Meng Fan had become all-knowing and all-powerful, and all past regrets could be corrected!
title: Eternal Rebirths

overview: A strong and intelligent career woman, Yu Xiling, crosses paths with Gu Zhaohe, a bold and fiery athlete, through a drunken misunderstanding. Sparks fly as their push-and-pull dynamic turns into mutual attraction. With a younger, straightforward lover making bold confessions, who will give in first? But just as romance heats up, her fiancé, who disappeared three years ago, reappears—what secrets and schemes lie behind his return?
title: In The Grip of Love

overview: In Jiangcheng, the prestigious perfume-making family faces a catastrophic fire set by their treacherous steward, who seizes their wealth. Lin Wanyue, an orphaned heiress, bides her time for years before returning to seek revenge. Upon her return, she reunites with Zhang Hanyi, the steward's son. Together, they embark on a journey of revenge, domestic intrigue, and business warfare, rising from humble beginnings in a modest courtyard to the pinnacle of success in a department store. Hand in hand, they overcome countless obstacles, battling enemies and fate alike.
title: Scent of New Dawn

overview: Baylen Out Loud Baylen Dupree, a vibrant and resilient 22-year-old with Tourette Syndrome. Every day, Baylen faces a variety of extreme and uncontrollable vocal and motor tics while navigating the challenges of becoming an independent adult. Supported by her loving family in West Virginia, including her five siblings, devoted boyfriend, Colin, protective father, Allen, and strong and independent mother, Julie, Baylen learns to manage the complexities of Tourette and embrace life fully.
title: Baylen Out Loud

overview: Covering day to day life within Ireland's favourite airline in a year which featured significant long haul expansion with ground-breaking new North American routes, staff upheavals and Dublin flyovers to celebrate the traditional kick-off to the US College Football season, it is set to feature all aspects from ground staff, baggage handlers, cabin crew and pilots as they plot the Shamrock's journey through another colourful year.
title: Inside Aer Lingus

overview: Secret Prankster Nitro enlists the help of his teammates as they aim to pull off some epic pranks on their fellow competitors: will Bionic wear a bunny costume at a calendar shoot for April? Will Viper fall for a fake influencer's demands? And behind the scenes at the live Gladiators shows in Sheffield, there are even pranks on unsuspecting members of the public, as well as the Gladiators going head-to-head in games like Rock, Paper, Scissors, and Charades. And yes, of course they are just as competitive outside the Arena as they are in it!
title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks

overview: Stage Stars immerses viewers in the lives of young performers at a UK boarding school specialising in dance and the performing arts. The series goes behind the scenes capturing all the ups and downs, the disappointments and celebrations as the young performers face challenges both inside and outside school. It utilises the wealth of talent available to enhance storytelling within the documentary, through unique, imaginative performance in break-out moments during each episode.
title: Stage Stars

overview: Set in modern-day Edinburgh, Gifted tells the story of a diverse group of young Scottish teens who discover they each have unique superpowers, from telekinesis to invisibility and mind reading. When they realise they're being targeted by a powerful organisation known as the Bodkin, they must join forces to protect themselves and those they love. With the guidance of their enigmatic teacher, Madame, the teens embark on a thrilling journey as they learn to control their powers and believe in themselves.
title: Gifted

overview: RTÉ has announced The Walsh Sisters, a new six-part drama series based on celebrated Irish author Marian Keyes' best-selling novels about a chaotic, dysfunctional but deeply loveable family of five sisters, a devout mother and a bemused father. Set in their Dublin hometown, The Walsh Sistersfollows the lives of Anna, Rachel, Maggie, Claire and Helen as they navigate the peaks and troughs of their late 20s and 30s. This is a sisterhood full of in-jokes, hand-me-down resentments and more than a few old wounds. But their DNA, history and shared love of power ballads keep the Walsh sisters together in the face of heartbreak, grief, addiction and parenthood.
title: The Walsh Sisters

overview: Witty, erudite and endlessly knowledgable about food, Irish chef Rory O'Connell returns with a collection of new recipes and helpful techniques for the holiday season. Rory prepares elegant dishes for cooks who want something a little different, including potted lobster, duck leg curry with Indian spieces and apple cider vinegar, a surprising Irish salad and apple Betty with chocolate and mincemeat.
title: How to Cook Well at Christmas with Rory O'Connell

overview: What happens if you hang a microphone on a coach in Europe's premier hockey league? A Kinopoisk documentary series about what doesn't make it onto TV.
title: Хороший гол: Тренер

overview: El Tiempo Entre Costuras is an adaptation of the same-titled novel by María Dueñas. The story begins in 1934. Between Youth and Adulthood… Sira Quiroga is a young seamstress from a traditional neighbourhood of Madrid who works with her mother Dolores in the haute couture workshop of Doña Manuela. At age twelve, Sira sweeps the atelier floors where her single mother works as a seamstress. At fourteen, she quietly begins her own apprenticeship. By her early twenties she has learned the ropes of the business and is engaged to a modest government clerk. But everything changes when two men burst unexpectedly into her neatly mapped-out life: an attractive salesman and the father she never knew.
title: El Tiempo Entre Costuras

overview: An elite cheerleading coach has her life flipped upside down when she's forced to start over with a new squad of lovable misfits. But to win the championship, they have no choice but to kick it into high cheer.
title: Stumble

overview: Oliver Callan romps through the 100 years since the 1921 Treaty using sketches and satire, retelling the cultural, political, entertainment and sports revolutions of the last century in Ireland.
title: Callan Kicks the Years

overview: Ring in the new year live in the intimate surrounds of Dublin Castle with a special guest.
title: New Year's Eve Live

overview: Join Ande and Órla at Crafty Christmas HQ.
title: Crafty Christmas

overview: This documentary series follows TV host Ilary Blasi as she defines her life post-divorce, balancing personal growth, career opportunities and a new love.
title: Ilary

overview: Sean Bean is Sharpe, a troubled outsider who, following an heroic act of bravery, finds himself promoted to the rank of officer. In this definitive collection of the acclaimed drama, follow his breathtaking adventures commanding the King's Rifles during the Napoleonic Wars.
title: Sharpe

overview: Narrated by Keith David, "Cold Case Files: Murder In the Bayou" features stories that the swamp threatened to swallow forever, but detectives managed to drag out into the light. These investigators, family, and friends know that no matter how deep in the muck it's buried, no sin stays secret forever.
title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou

overview: A team of stylishly savvy New York real estate agents hustle to seal multimillion-dollar deals while stirring up drama in this soapy reality series.
title: Selling the City

overview: Ordinary girl Ye Ruyi suddenly finds herself transported into a comic book, only to become a minor side character doomed to fail. Meanwhile, the antagonist Zuo Qianchen inexplicably awakens to self-awareness within the comic's world. From initial mutual suspicion to eventually joining forces to defy their predestined fates, they fight through the obstacles of the comic's rigid storyline, breaking free from its constraints. Through hardship, they find redemption in each other, and the blossoms of friendship and love bloom brightly as they rewrite their destinies together.
title: Ruyi

overview: Peek inside the lives of penguins, giraffes, chimps, and other animals that behave a whole lot like humans. Touch down on all seven continents around the world to see why these wild creatures compete, co-operate, love, and grieve just like we do.
title: Animals Like Us

overview: In 2004, Brazil stopped to follow the drama of the family of famous wrestler Vitor Belfort, who, accustomed to the glory of the octagon, was shaken by the disappearance of his sister, the cheerful Priscila. Amid theories and fake evidence, the search for her becomes endless, full of tortuous paths, somber characters and more doubts than answers, in a plot that includes politics, drug trafficking and the media. However, twenty years later, Priscila's real personality could be the key to put an end to this mysterious story.
title: Volta Priscila

overview: In Turtle Academy, two kids meet and then learn amazing skills from real-life pros who are inspired by the Turtles.
title: Turtle Academy

overview: Enjoy the glorious Yorkshire landscape in all its wintry, carol-singing splendour.
title: Our BIG Yorkshire Christmas

overview: Christmas special going behind the scenes at the UKs biggest retailers.
title: Who Does Christmas Better?!

overview: Featuring the missions of the Los Angeles Police Department's Special Weapons and Tactics team, a team of highly trained and heavily armed police officers whose purpose is to make coordinated assaults on armed and dangerous criminals in sensitive situations and defensible locations.
title: S.W.A.T.

overview: Wildlife presenter Steve Backshall is on an adventure to find out all about hippos in South Africa.
title: Milkshake! Hippo Watch

overview: An eye-opening journey to find out once and for all which is better: fresh or frozen food?
title: Fresh vs Frozen: Which Is Better?

overview: The feud between Edward VIII and his younger brother George VI, featuring first-hand accounts from people close to the story, and new evidence from historians.
title: Edward Vs George: The Windsors at War

overview: I am Married…But! explores the realities of married life. I-ling (Alice Ko) has lived with her in-laws for three years and contemplates divorce every seven days. She wants to move out but is stuck because her husband, Zeng Xue-you (Jasper Liu), is a mummy's boy. Despite her frustrations, she always finds a hint of charm in him at crucial moments, trapping her in a cycle of wanting to leave but not being able to. Things take a turn when she meets a soulmate on a dating app, her body suddenly wants a baby, placing her in a tug-of-war between emotional infidelity and family life.
title: I am Married…But!

overview: A night of ferocious clashes in Val di Susa. A team from the Mobile Unit of Rome loses their chief, who is seriously injured. Mazinga, Marta and Salvatore's team, however, is not like the others, it's a team from Rome, which had to learn to contrast chaos and troubles with extreme methods as well as with the harmony of a tribe, almost like a family. A family that the new commander, Michele, part of the reformist police, will have to deal with. For such police, teams like that are the symbol of an old school that must be refounded. As if the chaos that hits the new squad at the moment of maximum internal fragility wasn't enough, there's also a new wave of people's discontent with institutions. Among rising tensions, the team members are called to take sides and forced to question the deeper meaning of their work and their own membership of the Department.
title: ACAB

overview: Extraordinary World will follow everyday people who are making an impact through animal advocacy, wildlife conservation, youth empowerment and food insecurity aid.
title: Extraordinary World

overview: A show where popular comedians will show miniatures on the most different and unexpected topics. And star guests will help them! They will not only be the hosts, but will also take part in all the numbers.
title: Женское шоу

overview: A unique slant, profiling the life of Adolf Hitler as a child and his rise through the ranks of the National German Workers' Party prior to World War II.
title: Hitler: The Rise of Evil

overview: In the late 1990s, a mining town called Fengyang is shaken when the body of an unidentified woman is discovered. Police officer Chen Hongbing launches an investigation and soon notices that the glass fragments on the victim's neck closely resemble those from a bottle used to hold a banned drug. Not long after, while responding to a call, he discovers that someone in the town is consuming this illegal substance. Determined to uncover the truth and take down the drug trafficking ring, Chen Hongbing and his team dig deeper. But what he does not expect is that the person controlling everything behind the scenes is someone closest to him. Caught between duty and family, and torn between the law and human nature, this family and the entire town must face a test and a choice between good and evil.
title: Eight Hundred

overview: Betting on Paradise the couple, with two young daughters in tow, will embark on their biggest and scariest adventure yet—moving sight unseen to the coastal town of Jacó and buying a crumbling piece of prime real estate with the dream of creating a luxury boutique hotel. With the financial backing of friends and investors on the line, Luke will employ his construction background and years working in trades and Steph will tap into her high-end hospitality experience to overcome massive structural issues, frustrating delays and shocking budget increases to bring Hotel Amavi to life in time for peak tourist season.
title: Betting on Paradise

overview: It is officially the holiday season, and Christmas With The Australian Women's Weekly is the perfect inspiration for flawless festivities.
title: Christmas With The Australian Women's Weekly

overview: In a time where dictatorships were commonplace, Argentina hosted the most significant sport event on the planet. As thousands of people were abducted and taken to concentration camps, the military saw the World Cup as an opportunity to legitimize their power. Meanwhile, millions of Argentine fans followed the matches, seeking a glimmer of light between the dark. Across four episodes, this documentary weaves together soccer, horror, and political intrigue to tell a story that is both unique and unforgettable.
title: Argentina '78

overview: Join M/S Bjørvika on a wild tour along the Norwegian coast! Six participants join artist Vidar Villa at sea. The six live, work and party together, and compete to win the Mission M/S Bjørvika.
title: Oppdrag M/S Bjørvika

overview: An inspiring and entertaining renovation show where the two self-taught craftsmen Stine Skoli and Mads Clemmetsen travel to the hardware store and help realize people's dream projects.
title: Kan vi hjelpe til?

overview: In Frie Tøyler, viewers get to go inside the Norwegian galloping community, a fascinating world where strong personalities, lots of money, reputation and big dreams collide. The series is not only about fast horses and expensive competitions, but also provides a unique insight into the people who live and breathe the sport. This is a docu-reality that explores both the professional and personal lives of jockeys, trainers, horse owners, and the support system around the galloping sport. Through the season's six episodes, the audience gets up close and personal with their everyday lives, challenges, ups, downs, and the unique atmosphere that is created in their community.
title: Frie tøyler

overview: Master chef Kjartan Skjelde cleans up the kitchens of ten Norwegian celebrities who all need help finding the joy of food, inspiration and confidence to cook and invite friends home.
title: Kjartan rydder opp – hjemme

overview: Gunilla Persson travels to Norway to test Norwegian men. She throws herself into the dating world – but will the confident Norwegian handle her glamorous style and is there the right one for Gunilla here?
title: Den rette for Gunilla

overview: Artist Odd Nerdrum and his family open the doors to their private realm in this documentary series. Viewers get a rare opportunity to get up close to the family and one of Norway's most fascinating and controversial painters.
title: Familien Nerdrum

overview: Set immediately after movie "Golden Kamuy," the hunt for the escaped prisoners with the tattoos that collectively reveal the location of hidden gold is in full swing. Retired war veteran Sugimoto Saichi and Ainu native Asirpa are in the hunt to find the gold before others do so and their journey to find the gold nuggets enters a new phase.
title: Golden Kamuy: Hokkaido Shisei Shujin Soudatsuhen

overview: Taste follows the employees at a legacy food magazine in the Bay Area. When the publication is bought by a Silicon Valley tech mogul, its traditionalist editor is suddenly forced to work with a young, buzzy TikTok chef.
title: Taste

overview: In Duo, when a soft-spoken, blue-collar worker and a magnetic performer looking for her next break unexpectedly cross paths, their fateful meeting leads to a partnership that changes them both forever. The project is described as a family drama centered around a new two-person band and the disruption their rapidly rising career has on both their lives and the lives of those closest to them.
title: Duo

overview: After being brutally betrayed, Isabelle turns her hunger for vengeance into seduction – climbing her way amongst Paris' glittering elite.
title: Merteuil

overview: The series is based on the central couple of Louis and Isabelle and the people around them: the best friend of Louis, Francois Dion, Isabelle does not like, the best friend Isabelle, Maryse Lemieux, that Louis does not love their neighbors, Julien Champagne and his daughter Gabrielle; colleagues in the veterinary clinic where Dufour Louis works: Pamela Lalonde, Marjolaine Tremblay, not to mention Dr. Pascal Constantin ...
title: 4 et demi...

overview: Without a Trace is a fast-paced procedural drama about the Missing Persons Squad of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. The sole responsibility of the special task force is to find missing persons by applying advanced psychological profiling techniques to peel back the layers of the victims' lives and trace their whereabouts in an effort to discover whether they have been abducted, been murdered, committed suicide, or simply run away. The team reconstructs a "Day of Disappearance" timeline that details every minute of the 24 hours prior to the disappearance, following one simple rule: learn who the victim is in order to learn where the victim is. Senior agent Jack Malone heads the dedicated team that knows too well that every second counts when someone vanishes.
title: Without a Trace

overview: America has been bloodlessly taken over by the Soviet Union, leading to slave-labor camps for some, collaboration for others and rebellion for yet others.
title: Amerika

overview: A season of plays by Alan Bennett
title: Objects of Affection

overview: A 40-year secret comic book collection and the chance to write his own ending. Darren's father collected comic books in a genius yet obsessive way that destroyed the family. Now Darren holds the keys to 300,000 comics, a Superman #1, and a chance to change his family's legacy by selling one of the most expensive comics of all time.
title: Selling Superman

overview: Seonwoo, a man with an irresistible charm that leaves every girl bewitched and eager to confess, meets Jaeheon, who unexpectedly finds himself falling helplessly for him. Their story begins with a playful rivalry sparked by a daring bet—who will confess their feelings to the other person first.
title: You Want Some?

overview: Drama serial by John Howlett set five years after the murder of a moderate Middle Eastern politician.
title: Murder of a Moderate Man

overview: WWE LFG (Legends & Future Greats) will offer viewers an inside look at the rigorous training process, featuring iconic WWE Legends such as Paul "Triple H" Levesque and Shawn Michaels and weekly regular coaches Undertaker, Booker T, Mickie James and Bubba Ray Dudley as they mentor a new generation in weekly matches on their quest to become the next WWE Superstars.
title: WWE LFG

overview: WWE's Greatest Moments will feature legendary play-by-play announcer Michael Cole hosting half-hour episodes with various WWE Superstars & Legends, including "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Hulk Hogan, Kevin Owens and others, to share vivid recollections and perspectives on the most remarkable moments in wrestling history.
title: WWE's Greatest Moments

overview: The fallen heiress, Cheng Youran, changes her face and conceals her identity to avenge her mother's murder and reclaim her family property. Adopting the identity of her close friend, Su Xinyue, she pretends to have an engagement with Xu Shian, the heir of Xingyun Group and the son of her mother's killer. As she gathers evidence, Xu Shian gradually figures out her true identity. But, instead of exposing her, he silently protects her and secretly helps Cheng Youran with her revenge plan. As Cheng Youran peels back the layers of truth, she discovers that the true mastermind behind the tragedy was someone else.
title: Wild Rose

overview: Three years later, Sheng Mian and Fu Yancheng, who hadn't met each other, wanted to end their arranged and loveless marriage. They had several appointments, but always failed to meet. Accidentally, they had a one-night stand. When they met again, they misunderstood each other even more due to wrong emotional expressions. Fu Yancheng really regretted it when he got to know Sheng Mian was Penny and she was pregnant. He did everything he could to get her back. They finally straightened everything out, fell in love, and decided to spend the rest of their lives together.
title: Love on the Edge of Divorce

overview: After being fired from a major corporation, office worker Pei Qian receives an unexpected offer from a mysterious tycoon to start a company with a single goal: Losing money. He assembles a team of unreliable misfits and launches the "Pei Qian Plan", deliberately raising salaries, extending holidays, offering generous benefits, and investing in one absurd project after another in hopes of failure. Instead, every attempt backfires into success, turning losses into profits again and again. Pei Qian becomes a celebrated boss among his employees and a recognized business prodigy in the industry, while he himself suffers from getting rich against his will. With no escape, he continues searching for new opportunities to turn the tide and finally…
title: No Pain No Gain

overview: A new reality adventure series about Zoltan Horkai, a wild animal specialist who trains animals for the film and TV industry. He shares his home on a farm near Budapest in Hungary with more than 100 animals including packs of wolves, bears, dozens of wild boars, deer and many others. Zoltan runs the Horkai Animal Training Centre and is famous around the world for his training concept called Natural Motivation. His professional track record in animal casting and training is well known across the film industry in Europe and the USA. Zoltan worked on numerous Hollywood feature films, international documentaries and television commercials as animal trainer and wrangler for the past 15 years.
title: Zoltan the Wolfman

overview: At the Battle of Ice Lake, Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fall into the frozen lake. Chu Qiao is rescued by Yan Xun and learns that Zhuge Yue is dead. She seizes the opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun, avenging Zhuge Yue. In Bian Tang, Chu Qiao receives help time and again from a mysterious man. She feels a strange sense of familiarity, and can't help but suspect that Zhuge Yue may still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun grows even more ruthless, igniting war across four kingdoms. In the end, can Chu Qiao bring peace to the realm and make Yan Xun see the error of his ways? Can she stand side by side with Zhuge Yue once more, restoring a homeland for the people?
title: Rebirth

overview: A tale of love and ideals unfolds in an era resistant to diversity set against the backdrop of the political turmoil of 1969-1971. Trin, a principled economist, collides with Thanwa, a free-spirited hippie. When they encounter Moira, an extravagant widow who lives far beyond the boundaries of freedom, their lives take an unpredictable turn.
title: Shine

overview: Akin, an actor since childhood, has been recognized as "The Sexiest Man of the Year" in the entertainment industry for five consecutive years. However, his first-place position has been usurped by young newcomer actor Jin. While Akin first sees him as a rival, Jin, on the other hand, admires Akin greatly and is in love with him.
title: Top Form

overview: Krit is a handsome young police officer from a family of Chinese descent. He is deeply filial. Outwardly, he complies with his father's wishes by enrolling in the Police Academy following in his father's footsteps as a senior officer in the National Police Bureau. However, Krit never truly wanted to become a police officer. His family strongly opposes same-sex relationships, his father threatening harm if he were to date a man. As a result, Krit keeps his relationship with his boyfriend secret. Despite this, their love remains strong. Krit works hard to support his boyfriend's dream of becoming an idol, but after he succeeds, he cruelly abandons Krit. Heartbroken, Krit becomes cold and disinterested in love. Wayu is a student burdened by severe family issues. Neglected by his parents, he cares for his younger sister who later runs off after having a baby and leaving the child with Wayu. Forced to take responsibility, Wayu starts working at a nightclub. One day, during an altercation with a client, Krit comes to his rescue, marking the beginning of their relationship. For the first time, Wayu feels warmth and admiration for Krit and he determinedly makes frequent trips to the police station. Krit, at first, views Wayu with indifference. Over time, however, he begins encouraging Wayu through his hardships, leading to deeper bonds and mutual comfort.
title: Love of Silom

overview: This two-part programme explores the world of deep-sea killers, revealing mysterious creatures using cutting-edge CGI.
title: Monsters of the Deep: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea

overview: Step back in time and remember the tastes of your childhood, as we celebrate the iconic sweets and snacks we loved - and lost - across the decades. From Texan to Tooty Frooties, Fruit Salads to Flying Saucers, Parma Violets to Pacers, Horror Bags to Hedgehog Crisps... and treats that didn't stand the test of time, like Candy Cigarettes. Unwrapping the secret stories behind our favourite sweets and snacks, we also relive rituals - from the best way to tackle a Sherbet Fountain to the dangers of a black tongue after too many Black Jacks.
title: The Sweets & Treats We Loved & Lost

overview: The Mediterranean is home to some of the most spectacular islands and coastlines. Across this series, narrated by Joanna Lumley, we meet locals and tourists, sample mouthwatering local cuisine and explore ancient traditions as we uncover the true Jewels of the Med.
title: Jewels of the Mediterranean

overview: In the down-home medical series, Jack Albertson played an elderly country doctor in Dixon Mills, USA, who was training his young successor, Simon Locke. The first season was televised by some Canadian stations, despite not being aired across the entire CTV network. As Simon Locke transitioned from a rural physician to a major city police surgeon, the show's title was changed to Police Surgeon after the first season.
title: Police Surgeon

overview: One day, in a quiet Meshchersk near Moscow, events occur that dramatically change the lives of seven friends-classmates who have just graduated from school, as well as their older relatives. On a dark suburban highway, the guys hit a pedestrian with a car, who mysteriously disappears from the scene of the accident. The car belongs to a well-known person in the city - a successful businessman nicknamed the Cossack, and his nephew, the Cossack, drove it. The incident can get loud publicity and serious consequences: the Cossack has just concluded a lucrative deal with foreign investors, who will certainly refuse to cooperate if they find out that their new partner is involved in crime.
title: Казаки-разбойники

overview: A private banker, known for managing assets of high-net-worth clients, excels in protecting their wealth with extensive financial expertise and a wide network of connections
title: Private Banker

overview: Devil's Ranch follows a group of ex-military personnel who operate a ranch on the Texas-Mexico border by day and conduct various missions across the globe by night.
title: Devil's Ranch

overview: The series revolves around the siblings Jiang Mu, the sheltered and pampered younger sister, and Jin Zhao, the extremely gifted older brother. When Mu is nine years old, their parents get a divorce and her father and Zhao move to Thailand. As such, Mu and Zhao's lives become two paths that never cross. After learning that her brother is adopted, Mu flies to Thailand alone. When they meet again, the once elegant boy has transformed into a rugged young man hardened by the streets. Zhao is now into boxing and racing, living a life full of wild thrills and danger that is completely unfamiliar to Mu. Undaunted, Mu works to assimilate into the life of Zhao and her father's family. Aligning with her talents, her studies and life in Thailand are just as splendid, and her enthusiasm and empathy brightens Zhao's life. As Zhao's co-pilot, she is his perfect navigator. Seeing that Zhao is stuck in a quagmire, she decides to pull him out and take him home. When an accident separates the two again, Mu takes on the responsibility of taking care of the family while fulfilling their shared ambition and aerospace dream. Many years later, Mu returns to China after graduation. Mu and Zhao reunite again in Nanjing, expressing their affection to each other in their own ways. From then on, like the glorious sun in the day and the bright moon in the night, their love shine and glow for an eternity, never to be separated again
title: Speed and Love
